payload.summary: The meeting page for the Licensing committee due to sit at 4.30pm on 17 September 2026 — the meeting the council said the consultation results would go to. When this page was saved on 7 September 2026 it showed the meeting as scheduled and said there were currently no documents for it. Norwich normally publishes agendas about five working days beforehand, so papers would be expected around 9 or 10 September.
